key.name: translate-shortcut
key.description: Global keybinding to translate the current selection. Empty by default; set it in the extension preferences.

key.name: watch-enabled
key.description: Automatically translate selected text without pressing the hotkey.

key.name: google-api-key
key.description: When set, the official Google Cloud Translation v2 endpoint is used instead of the free web endpoint. Leave empty to use the free endpoint.

key.name: popup-width
key.description: 弹窗默认宽度，实际显示时再按屏幕尺寸收敛。

key.name: popup-height
key.description: 弹窗默认高度，实际显示时最多占屏幕高度的 80%。
